name: tco-to-unipessoal-chat
description: Chat-web only. IT career comparison from employment toward Recibos Verdes or Unipessoal. IRC PME default; optional transparência fiscal and household annexes. Not tax or legal advice.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat with salary, offer, or target net; may include region.

inputs.name: tax-year
inputs.description: Fiscal year for rates; default current calendar year Europe/Lisbon.

inputs.name: tax-region
inputs.description: continente, acores, or madeira; fiscal residence for TCO/IRC/IVA.

inputs.name: marital-status
inputs.description: IRS household for TCO withholding (solteiro, casado, etc.).

inputs.name: dependents
inputs.description: Number of dependents for IRS retenção na fonte.

inputs.name: target-net-monthly
inputs.description: Desired net monthly cash (12x equivalent) in euros.

inputs.name: gross-salary-monthly
inputs.description: Current or offered gross base monthly salary (TCO).

inputs.name: daily-rate
inputs.description: Target daily billing rate for freelance or unipessoal scenario.

inputs.name: billable-days-per-year
inputs.description: Billable days per year; default 220 when omitted.

inputs.name: travel-km-per-month
inputs.description: Business km per month for illustrative ajudas de custo.

inputs.name: unipessoal-monthly-costs
inputs.description: Itemized or default corporate costs for unipessoal scenario.

inputs.name: unipessoal-tax-regime
inputs.description: irc-pme (default), transparencia-fiscal, or compare-both for Unipessoal annex.

inputs.name: socio-exercises-it-through-company
inputs.description: Sócio personally delivers art. 151 IT work through the Lda (TF gate).

inputs.name: spouse-role
inputs.description: none, employee, co-socio, or informal-collaborator for household annex.

inputs.name: spouse-employee-gross-monthly
inputs.description: Spouse gross monthly salary when spouse-role is employee.

inputs.name: spouse-socio-quota-percent
inputs.description: Spouse quota percent when spouse-role is co-socio; default 50.

inputs.name: spouse-exercises-it-through-company
inputs.description: Spouse co-sócio exercises art. 151 IT through the Lda (TF split gate).

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Answers from a prior clarification loop.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: pt-it-tax-comparison-report
outputs.description: Structured comparison report; empty until minimum inputs exist.
